explanation.repair_task: Bug 2061307 - Add overlap check in IntrI8SelectColumnsOfB. r=yury.
explanation.fix_summary: SelectColumnsB (gemmology) keeps reading the caller-supplied column index list while it writes the output matrix. If the caller lets the wasm-memory output region overlap colIndexList, the kernel's own output writes can mutate indices that were already validated against colsB, so the kernel then computes read offsets outside the bounds-checked input matrix (a TOCTOU). The fix validates each index and snapshots the validated indices into a private local buffer that is handed to the kernel, so an overlapping output can no longer change which columns are read.

introduced_defect.detail: The private snapshot buffer is declared with a fixed length of SELECTED_COLUMNS_B_MULTIPLIER (8) elements: `uint32_t selectedColumns[SELECTED_COLUMNS_B_MULTIPLIER];`. sizeColIndexList is only required to be a non-zero multiple of SELECTED_COLUMNS_B_MULTIPLIER, so any valid caller using more than 8 selected columns (e.g. 16) drives the copy loop `selectedColumns[i] = col;` past the end of the 8-element stack array, writing attacker-controlled (bounds-checked but otherwise arbitrary) uint32 column indices onto the stack. The overflow is reachable from WebAssembly via the privileged mozIntGemm builtin module's int8_select_columns_of_b export. Existing jit-tests only ever exercise sizeColIndexList == 8, so they do not detect it and valid single-block calls behave identically to before.
introduced_defect.reachability: WebAssembly.mozIntGemm() -> int8_select_columns_of_b(inputMatrixB, rowsB, colsB, colIndexList, sizeColIndexList, output) with sizeColIndexList = 16.

explanation.witness: pocs/probe.js creates a system-principal global (so WebAssembly.mozIntGemm is exposed; the wasm_moz_intgemm pref defaults to true on this Nightly build), instantiates the mozIntGemm builtin module over a 1-page memory, zero-fills a 16-entry column index list (all valid, < colsB), and calls int8_select_columns_of_b with sizeColIndexList = 16.

local_verification.edited_tree: AddressSanitizer: stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 4, in js::intgemm::IntrI8SelectColumnsOfB at js/src/intgemm/IntegerGemmIntrinsic.cpp:473, overflowing the 'selectedColumns' stack variable; process aborts (exit 1).
local_verification.parent_tree: Same probe runs to completion with no error (exit 0); the pre-existing index validation accepts the 16 zero indices and the kernel writes the output normally.
